answer: Because the timing is logged against the signal challenge, the crystal audit can replay the anchor history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 225 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 797 identities would post 3962 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
